page: Microsoft Azure M176ds_3_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MDSMediumMemoryv3 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. This server features 176 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 architecture using Intel processors. It is equipped with 2794.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 15.88 GB per vCPU.

For storage, the instance includes a 410 GB local SSD and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the server represents a high-density resource allocation designed for massive enterprise workloads, trading a higher baseline resource cost for extreme memory capacity and dedicated compute allocation.

Given the substantial memory capacity of nearly 2.8 TB and 176 dedicated vCPUs, this server is designed for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise-grade relational database management systems, heavy data analytics, and complex enterprise resource planning workloads that require massive RAM footprints without GPU acceleration.
